assumptions: One exogenous changepoint per machine. No gradual blend between regimes.
Even slots start in regime 0 and odd slots start in regime 1, so the two steady slots (and other same-type pairs) begin in opposite regimes.
The episode anchor is shared. Machine offsets are -8,-4,0,0,4,8 ticks.
Anchor and offset ignore outcomes and do not depend on n_ticks.
P(observe) and the structural gap (tick + 3*slot) % 11 == 0 are exogenous. A missing row still has a latent payout in the log; features must ignore it.
The query signal is exogenous at the cutoff only. It is not a history feature.
No parameter was fit on organizer train, validation, or test files.
rule: Use organizer-released data. No verified synthetic exception.
